prova:
obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, n = 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 := ⟨2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2, rfl⟩
refine ⟨m, Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt hm) hm)), fun i : Fin m => (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro i j hij
  rw [add_right_inj (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)]
  simpa using hij
· intro i
  have h : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt hm) (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (by omega)))
  have : 0 < 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 := by
    have : m + 2 ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) := by
      have : m + 1 ≥ 2 := by omega
      have : 2 ^ (m + 1) ≥ 2 ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      omega
    omega
  omega
· have hn : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) / (2 ^ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) : ℚ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), k / (2 ^ k : ℚ) := by
    exact erdos_261.variants.borwein_loring m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega))
  calc
    (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) / (2 ^ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) : ℚ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), k / (2 ^ k : ℚ) := hn
    _ = ∑ i : Fin m, ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1) / (2 ^ ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1) : ℚ) := by
      have h_pos : 0 < m := by omega
      have h_nonempty : (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).Nonempty := by
        by_cases h : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) < (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m
        · exact Finset.nonempty_Ioc.mpr (by
            have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m ≤ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m := by omega
            omega)
        · exfalso; omega
      have h_eq : (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).card = m := by
        have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ≤ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m := by omega
        have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m > 0 := by omega
        rw [Finset.card_Ioc]
        <;> simp_all [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        <;> omega
      have h_bij : (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).image (fun k : ℕ => k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) = Finset.range m := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro x
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
          have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) < k := by
            rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 ≤ k)]
            exact (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).1
          have : k ≤ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).2
          have : 0 < k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) := by omega
          have : k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) < m := by omega
          omega
        · rintro h
          use (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + x
          have : x < m := h
          have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) < (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + x := by omega
          have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + x ≤ (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m := by omega
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by
            simp [Nat.add_sub_cancel, h]⟩
      calc
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), k / (2 ^ k : ℚ)
            = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), ((k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (k : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k hk
          have : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ≤ k := by
            rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 ≤ k)]
            exact (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk).1
          have : k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) = k := by omega
          simpa [this] using rfl
        _ = ∑ i : Fin m, ((i.1) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ ((i.1) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) : ℚ) := by
          have hB : (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).image (fun k : ℕ => k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) = Finset.range m := h_bij
          have hcard : (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).card = m := h_eq
          have hinj : Function.InjectiveOn (fun k : ℕ => k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)) := by
            intro k hk1 l hk2 hkl
            have hk1' : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ≤ k := by
              rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 ≤ k)]
              exact (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk1).1
            have hk2' : (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ≤ l := by
              rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2 ≤ l)]
              exact (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hk2).1
            have : k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) = l - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) := hkl
            have hk' : k = (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + (k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) := by omega
            have hl' : l = (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + (l - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) := by omega
            rw [hk', hl', this]
          -- Use the bijection to rewrite the sum
          have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), ((k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (k : ℕ) : ℚ) = ∑ i : Fin m, (i.1 + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (i.1 + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) : ℚ) := by
            have : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m), ((k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (k : ℕ) : ℚ) = ∑ x ∈ (Finset.Ioc (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + m)).image (fun k : ℕ => k - (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)), (x + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (x + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) : ℚ) := by
              apply Finset.sum_image_of_injective_on
              exact hinj
              <;> simp [hB]
            rw [this, hB]
            calc
              ∑ x ∈ Finset.range m, (x + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (x + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) : ℚ)
                  = ∑ i : Fin m, (i.1 + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) / (2 ^ (i.1 + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2)) : ℚ) := by
                have : (Finset.range m).card = m := by simp
                have hcard2 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).card = m := by simp
                -- Use the fact that Fin m is in bijection with range m
                apply Finset.sum_bij' (fun i : Fin m => i.1) (fun x => ⟨x, by omega⟩)
                <;> simp_all [Fin.val_lt]
                <;> try omega
          rw [hsum]
        _ = ∑ i : Fin m, ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1) / (2 ^ ((2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1) : ℚ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          have : i.1 + (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) = (2 ^ (m + 1) - m - 2) + 1 + i.1 := by
            have : i.1 ≥ 1 := by omega
            omega
          rw [this, add_assoc]
